::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 7th 1872  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Yonge Letters: Huntington Library
:::

Miss Yonge sends up a parcel of books for which she will be obliged if [Messrs Reeves & Turner](organizations/other_239.qmd) will send her an order as before

---

**Note:** Perhaps this relates to the sale of review copies?
